# GradeLake

> GradeLake is a web app for teachers and tutors that turns a test into printable, scannable answer sheets and grades the scanned or photographed sheets into a CSV. It handles multiple-choice questions and handwritten free-response questions.

## What it does

- Sheet Generator: loads a test (questions, choices, answer key, point values, optional graphs, diagrams and tables) and produces answer sheets for US Letter paper, previewable in the browser and downloadable as a PDF. Each sheet has a QR code and corner marks so it can be read from a scan or phone photo.
- Grader: reads scanned or photographed sheets, reads the filled bubbles, transcribes handwritten free-response answers with an AI model, and grades them against a model answer and rubric. The teacher reviews names, unclear marks and written answers before exporting a CSV, and can curve selected questions.
- Library: stores tests in nested groups; tests can be published for other signed-in teachers to copy.

## Pricing and access

- Free plan: browse, create and share study material, generate study guides, quizzes and exams from any material, print answer sheets, keep a library.
- Pro plan ($5/month, 7-day free trial): required to grade scanned sheets.

## Privacy note

- Filled bubbles are read by GradeLake itself. Images of the name box and of handwritten answers are sent to AI models to be read and graded.
